messages.subject: Partable from fitted model object doesn't match parameter table from lavaanify()?
parts:
Hi,  I am doing sem with a bunch of different models.  For one model the parameter table from the fitted model object has an extra row compared to the parameter table generated by lavaanify.  This doesn't happen for the other 80 models I am working with.  I understand that there are extra parameters required for a full specification than are given in a lavaan syntax.  However, I thought it was lavaanify()'s job to parse the syntax and include those extra parameters.  Why is the sem function coming up with an extra parameter in this case?  thanks MLT

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Partable from fitted model object doesn't match parameter table from lavaanify()?
parts:
> lavaanify(m36.sem)

lavaanify() without any further arguments will NOT add any 'default'
parameters (as if you were using the sem() function).

In your case, try adding auto.var = TRUE and auto.cov.y = TRUE, OR if
you want to mimic the sem() function, just auto = TRUE

Yves.
